title: connector-openapi: query parameters are sent through `String(value)`, so an object or array value (`style: deepObject`, `explode`) goes out as `[object Object]` or a comma list instead of the encoding the document declares
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location, `finding` class (a) (reproducible). Found by the os-dev on #28276 (the Stripe app, PR #28503) and re-read by this seat. Child of #27293 (E1). ⛔ Not a claim.

`reach:` public door — `POST /api/v1/automation/:flow/trigger` running a `connector_action` on a declarative `openapi` instance. Named real producer: Stripe's `spec3.json` (`stripe/openapi`, MIT), whose list operations declare `expand`, `created` and `due_date` as query parameters with `style: deepObject` (GetInvoices, GetCharges, GetCustomers, GetPaymentIntents). Measured by the dev (one-off `bootStack` probe, fake `fetchImpl` recording the URL): `created: { gte: 1700000000 }` went out as `created=%5Bobject+Object%5D`, `expand: ['a', 'b']` as `expand=a%2Cb`, and the run answered 200. Stripe's own answer is NOT MEASURED (no key).

## The defect

`packages/connectors/connector-openapi/src/openapi-connector.ts:563` (read at `origin/main` 2026-11-01T03:40Z): `url.searchParams.set(key, String(value))`; the path builder (`:592`) does the same with `encodeURIComponent(String(value))`. The parameter's `style` / `explode` (OpenAPI 3.x Parameter Object) are never read, while the action's input schema advertises the object/array shape — so an author or an AI that fills the advertised input sends a malformed request, and nothing says so.

`Seam: spec: OpenAPI 3.x Parameter Object style / explode → runtime: packages/connectors/connector-openapi/src/openapi-connector.ts buildUrl / stringifyValues`

## Work

Serialize query (and path) parameters by their declared `style` and `explode` (at least `form` explode true/false for arrays, `deepObject` for objects; the OpenAPI 3.x defaults when absent), or refuse at materialization an operation whose parameter uses a style the connector does not serialize — never `String()` a non-scalar. Tests: the three Stripe shapes above as fixtures, plus a scalar control.

## Business reason

Every list call on Stripe (and most large vendor APIs) filters by date ranges or expands related objects through these parameters; today the request is silently wrong.

## Reader

The triage seat grades and routes it (`domain:server`, `connector-openapi`); the epic PM of #27293 dispatches.

## Dedupe

The 500 most recent issues and PRs (read 2026-11-01T03:42Z), titles grepped for `deepObject|explode|query string|object Object`: 0 hits; control `openapi` on the same set: 7 hits.
